reply_text.comment:
Hello,

Thank you for reaching out regarding the webhook failures and database migration errors. Based on your description, it appears to be a technical issue related to your recent database migration.

Please ensure that your webhook endpoints are correctly configured and accessible after the migration. Additionally, verify that your database connection settings are updated and correct. You may also want to review the logs for any connectivity issues or errors like DB-504.

For detailed guidance, please refer to our KB article on database migration best practices and webhook troubleshooting.

If the issue persists, let us know, and we can escalate this to our technical support team for further assistance.
